entries.3d9453dd1dcbf052: The largest business of the group, responsible for the design and fabrication of steel frames and towers and on-site erection. It has supplied steel frames for many notable buildings, including super-high-rise buildings. It owns 2 S-grade certified plants, the highest grade after review by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and handles all processes from design and fabrication to construction. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external revenue was ¥20,508 million, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 207. The company, Tohoku Tekkotsu Kyoryo Co., Ltd., Ships Co., Ltd., KH Facilitec Co., Ltd. and others handle this business.

entries.b8e3eaf021af11ec: A business engaged in the manufacture and on-site construction of onshore wind power generation equipment, and in overseas business centered on infrastructure. It provides total services for onshore wind power generation equipment with a rated output of 300 kW, from preliminary surveys to maintenance, and is also developing a model with a rated output of 1 MW. For offshore wind turbine towers, a tower manufacturing plant for large wind turbines was completed at the Futtsu Plant in March 2026; however, no revenue from tower manufacturing has been recorded at this time, and development costs are ahead of revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external revenue was ¥190 million, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 33. The company and 1 other company handle this business.

entries.f839473238aa0ea8: A business responsible for the design and fabrication of bridges, on-site erection, on-site construction of steel bridges, and maintenance and repair. Having entered the bridge field by applying manufacturing technology developed in the steel frame business, it can handle the entire bridge construction process within the group, from quantity takeoff and cost estimation for steel bridges through design, fabrication and on-site construction. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external revenue was ¥13,170 million, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 280. The company and Tohoku Tekkotsu Kyoryo Co., Ltd. handle this business.
